name: Classical Baselines
purpose: Establish cheap, interpretable motion and scheduling baselines before evaluating learned communication-aware models.
work_items: evaluate Last Position / Constant Velocity / Constant Acceleration
evaluate Kalman and IMM where implemented
define information-oracle predictor for upper-bound diagnostics
evaluate Random / Round Robin / Reactive Greedy / proportional-fair baselines
evaluate classical predictive scheduling using future geometry estimates
verify identical traffic/link configuration across policy comparisons
acceptance_criteria: all baseline predictors expose the same causal forecast interface
all schedulers consume the same queue and link-state contract
baseline raw per-scenario outputs are archived
oracle is documented as information oracle rather than global optimum
no learned model is required to reproduce baseline tables
forbidden: using ground-truth future in deployable baselines
comparing schedulers under different traffic seeds/configs
